data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD6: Unit tests written (failing RED) for all new loop-back and termination logic

## Implementation Steps

1. Create `tests/skills/test-brainstorm-loop-back.sh` (chmod +x) following the established brainstorm test pattern:
   - Shebang: `#!/usr/bin/env bash`
   - `set -euo pipefail`
   - `REPO_ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)`
   - `SKILL_MD="${REPO_ROOT}/plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md"`
   - `PASS=0; FAIL=0; SECTION="unknown"`
   - `pass() { echo "  PASS: $1"; PASS=$((PASS + 1)); }`
   - `fail() { echo "FAIL: ${SECTION}"; echo "  FAIL: $1"; FAIL=$((FAIL + 1)); }`

   Sections to implement:

   **test_loop_back_on_gap** (DD1, DD2):
   ```bash
   SECTION="test_loop_back_on_gap"
   if grep -qiE 'loop.?back.*[Tt]ell [Mm]e [Mm]ore|[Tt]ell [Mm]e [Mm]ore.*loop.?back|return.*[Tt]ell [Mm]e [Mm]ore.*loop' "$SKILL_MD"; then
     pass "SKILL.md Phase 1 Gate Step 2 contains loop-back to Tell Me More directive"
   else
     fail "SKILL.md Phase 1 Gate Step 2 missing loop-back to Tell Me More directive"
   fi
   ```

   **test_termination_both_conditions** (DD3):
   ```bash
   SECTION="test_termination_both_conditions"
   if grep -qiE 'empty.*gap.*list|gap.*list.*empty|gap list is empty|no.*remaining.*gap' "$SKILL_MD"; then
     pass "SKILL.md contains empty-gap-list termination condition"
   else
     fail "SKILL.md missing empty-gap-list termination condition"
   fi
   if grep -qiE 'no numeric cap|no.*cap.*applied|no cap' "$SKILL_MD"; then
     pass "SKILL.md confirms no numeric cap on loop"
   else
     fail "SKILL.md missing no-numeric-cap statement"
   fi
   ```

   **test_unresolvable_intent_gap** (DD5):
   ```bash
   SECTION="test_unresolvable_intent_gap"
   if grep -q 'UNRESOLVABLE_INTENT_GAP' "$SKILL_MD"; then
     pass "SKILL.md contains UNRESOLVABLE_INTENT_GAP escape"
   else
     fail "SKILL.md missing UNRESOLVABLE_INTENT_GAP escape"
   fi
   if grep -qiE 'suppress.*every|suppresses.*all|every candidate.*suppress|all.*candidate.*suppress' "$SKILL_MD"; then
     pass "SKILL.md documents anti-redundancy suppression trigger for UNRESOLVABLE_INTENT_GAP"
   else
     fail "SKILL.md missing anti-redundancy suppression trigger for UNRESOLVABLE_INTENT_GAP"
   fi
   ```

   **test_ux_probe_named_symbol** (DD4):
   ```bash
   SECTION="test_ux_probe_named_symbol"
   if grep -qE 'criticality|non_happy_path|flow_entry_exit' "$SKILL_MD"; then
     pass "SKILL.md references UX probe checkpoint by named dimension IDs"
   else
     fail "SKILL.md missing UX probe checkpoint named symbol reference (dimension IDs: criticality, non_happy_path, flow_entry_exit)"
   fi
   ```

   End the test file with standard Results block and exit 1 on any FAIL.

2. Append 4 RED markers to the existing `plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md:` entry line in `.test-index` (append to the comma-separated list on that existing line — do NOT add new lines with the same key):
   ```
   , tests/skills/test-brainstorm-loop-back.sh [test_loop_back_on_gap]
   , tests/skills/test-brainstorm-loop-back.sh [test_termination_both_conditions]
   , tests/skills/test-brainstorm-loop-back.sh [test_unresolvable_intent_gap]
   , tests/skills/test-brainstorm-loop-back.sh [test_ux_probe_named_symbol]
   ```

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given: SKILL.md does not yet contain loop-back directive or UNRESOLVABLE_INTENT_GAP text
When: grep for loop-back pattern runs on SKILL.md
Then: exits 1 (RED — the text doesn't exist yet)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `tests/skills/test-brainstorm-loop-back.sh` created and executable
  Verify: test -x tests/skills/test-brainstorm-loop-back.sh
- [ ] Running the test exits non-zero (RED) before SKILL.md is amended
  Verify: bash tests/skills/test-brainstorm-loop-back.sh; [ $? -ne 0 ] && echo RED_CONFIRMED
- [ ] .test-index SKILL.md entry now contains all 4 new section markers (appended to existing line)
  Verify: grep 'plugins/dso/skills/brainstorm/SKILL.md' .test-index | grep -q 'test_loop_back_on_gap'
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — NOTE: this RED test itself will fail; the test gate handles RED markers
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh || true
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && eval "$LINT_CMD" || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && eval "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" || true

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
